mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever FEDFUNDS shows a rising trend, regardless of absolute level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS shows a rising trend, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate above 4.0% (UNRATE > 4.0%) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing corporate hiring and consumer spending expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a month-over-month CPI increase signals imminent aggressive Fed tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% and rises month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active whenever INDPRO shows an upward trend.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO shows a rising trend, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.0% (derived from GDPC1) signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS increase < 50k) combined with stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change ≤ 0%) signals an economy without monetary support, reducing corporate hiring and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is below 50k and FEDFUNDS is stable or rising, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1500.0), a further decline in housing starts signals continued consumer sector weakness, reducing retail sales and corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1500.0 and declines, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
